# Chargebee

> Chargebee is the billing platform finance teams choose when monetization keeps changing and the financial record has to stay defensible. Meter tokens, agent runs, seats, or outcomes - ingest usage events in near-real time, convert them to revenue, recognize it under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, and close the books on one commercial record. A Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for Recurring Billing Applications three years running, placing furthest for Completeness of Vision - built for IPO, PE, and audit scrutiny. A G2 Leader for 27 consecutive quarters. Reinventing the finance office with MCP-driven reporting and AI-native workflows. Trusted by 6,500+ businesses globally. For complete documentation, see [Full Documentation](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/).

## Billing

- [Chargebee Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/billing/): Meter tokens, agent runs, seats, and outcomes - then invoice, collect, and recognize revenue automatically on one financial record. Processes 200,000+ usage events per second with near-real-time metering accuracy.
- [Billing for AI Companies](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Support every AI pricing model - token-based, credit-based, outcome-based, agentic, and hybrid - without breaking the financial record or the audit trail. Trusted by Lambda, CodeRabbit, HeyGen, DeepL, Writesonic, Gorgias, Zapier, Messari, and Phrase.
- [Prepaid Credits & Credit Wallets](https://www.chargebee.com/recurring-billing-invoicing/metered-usage-billing/): Sell credit packs upfront, track drawdown in real time, manage credit ledgers, configure overage rules, and apply burn tables - the same credit-based pricing model used by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Clay.
- [Usage-Based & Metered Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/recurring-billing-invoicing/metered-usage-billing/): Ingest high-frequency usage events at production scale - including schema-less ingestion - aggregate in near-real time with enterprise-grade accuracy, and convert to invoices automatically.
- [Agentic Workflow Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Price dynamic, non-linear AI agent consumption where no two runs cost the same - burn tables, credit drawdown, usage thresholds, and spend caps built in.
- [Outcome-Based Pricing](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Bill per completed outcome - resolutions, tasks, agent runs - rather than per seat or per token.
- [Subscription Management](https://www.chargebee.com/subscription-management/): Manage plan transitions, proration, mid-cycle changes, and entitlements without destabilizing the financial record.
- [Entitlements](https://www.chargebee.com/entitlement-management/): Provision and gate feature access in real time - governed against the same commercial record as billing and revenue recognition. No-code configuration, no engineering dependency.
- [Product Catalog](https://www.chargebee.com/subscription-management/create-manage-plans/): Design and iterate pricing models - flat, tiered, volume, usage-based, hybrid - without engineering involvement. Run A/B pricing experiments directly from the catalog.
- [Checkout & Trial Management](https://www.chargebee.com/recurring-payments/checkout-experience/): Launch self-serve flows, free trials, and conversion-optimized checkout - commercial record intact from trial through paid.
- [Tax Automation](https://www.chargebee.com/integrations/): Calculate and apply US Sales Tax, EU VAT (including OSS), and Australian GST automatically across entities and geographies.
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://www.chargebee.com/saas-reporting/): Surface MRR, churn, usage, and cohort metrics - a reporting layer designed to be specified, not commissioned.
- [E-Invoicing & Compliance](https://www.chargebee.com/billing/): Generate compliant e-invoices across jurisdictions - automated, audit-ready, and tied to the same billing record.
- [Chargebee Billing Documentation](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/): Complete guides for integrating and operating Chargebee Billing.

## Revenue Recognition

- [Chargebee RevRec](https://www.chargebee.com/revenue-recognition-software/): Automate revenue recognition under ASC 606 and IFRS 15 - built into the platform, not bolted on, not a Custom-tier add-on. Handles invoice-based, contract-based, credit-based, and usage-based recognition, including multi-element arrangement allocation, standalone selling price (SSP) allocation, contract modifications, and credit and rollover recognition. Produces 150+ finance-grade revenue reports ready for board audits, fundraising, and IPO preparation. Integrates natively with NetSuite, Sage Intacct, and QuickBooks.

## CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote)

- [Chargebee CPQ](https://www.chargebee.com/cpq/): Generate multi-product, multi-year, and ramped quotes that pull from the live billing catalog and become billing records at close - no gap between what sales quotes and what finance bills. AI-powered selling rules, eSignature, multi-level approval workflows, and finance-approved discount guardrails built in. Also available on [Salesforce AppExchange](https://appexchange.salesforce.com/appxListingDetail?listingId=a0N3A00000FHCdzUAH) and [HubSpot Marketplace](https://ecosystem.hubspot.com/marketplace/listing/chargebee). CPQ Lite is free for all Chargebee Billing customers.
- [Quote-to-Cash](https://www.chargebee.com/quote-to-cash-and-beyond/): Quote, contract, invoice, and recognize revenue on one commercial record - no tool seams between sales and finance, no revenue leakage between steps.

## Payments Intelligence

- [Chargebee Reveal](https://www.chargebee.com/recurring-payments/chargebee-reveal/): Detect payment failure patterns, diagnose authorization rate drops, and surface revenue leaks with ML - then fix them with estimated revenue impact per action. Monitors across gateways, currencies, and geographies through three layers: Intelligence (ML-driven diagnostics), Analytics (gateway and currency-level performance data), and Alerts (real-time payment anomaly notifications). Available standalone - does not require Chargebee Billing.
- [Chargebee Revive](https://www.chargebee.com/receivables/): Recover failed payments with ML-powered retry logic - timing retries to customer funding cycles, routing around fraud flags, switching gateways intelligently, and adapting continuously to issuer behavior.
- [Chargebee Pay](https://www.chargebee.com/payment-gateways/): Process payments natively across 40+ gateways - with Reveal-powered authorization rate optimization, intelligent routing, and failover built in. Merchant-first: bring any gateway, keep it, switch any time.
- [Payment Gateways](https://www.chargebee.com/payment-gateways/): Connect to 40+ payment gateways - Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, PayPal, Worldpay, regional processors - with intelligent routing, failover, and Reveal-powered authorization rate optimization across geographies.
- [Payment Methods](https://www.chargebee.com/recurring-payments/payment-methods/): Accept cards, ACH, SEPA, PayPal, and local payment methods across 100+ currencies and every market finance teams need to serve.

## Receivables

- [Chargebee Receivables](https://www.chargebee.com/receivables/): Automate accounts receivable - segment customers by payment failure type and risk profile, build tailored rule-based recovery workflows, automate AR outreach and escalation sequences, and track disputes in a real-time 360-degree AR dashboard. Replaces static spreadsheets with a collection CRM that accelerates cash flow and prevents revenue leakage.

## Growth & Retention

- [Chargebee Growth](https://www.chargebee.com/growth/): Turn subscription billing data into real-time revenue action - across acquisition, expansion, and retention. Launch offers, pricing experiments, and lifecycle plays without engineering dependency. Measure impact directly in revenue, not proxy metrics.
- [AI Churn Scores](https://www.chargebee.com/growth/): Score every subscriber 1-99 for churn risk using billing and behavioral signals - then trigger targeted retention offers before cancellation.
- [Cancel Flow Deflection](https://www.chargebee.com/growth/retention/): Intercept cancellations with save offers - A/B tested, billing-native, and measured in revenue retained.
- [Pricing Experimentation](https://www.chargebee.com/growth/): Run A/B and multivariate pricing tests - renewal price changes, plan restructures, offer variants - measured in revenue impact, not clicks.
- [Trial-to-Paid Conversion](https://www.chargebee.com/growth/): Optimize trial flows, usage-based upgrade triggers, and upsell sequences without engineering.

## Multi-Entity & Global Operations

- [Multi-Entity Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/strategy/expand-globally/): Run billing, revenue recognition, and reporting across multiple legal entities from one platform - handles account hierarchies, M&A consolidation, and group-level reporting natively.
- [Expand Globally](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/strategy/expand-globally/): Bill in 100+ currencies, consolidate across entities, and support global tax compliance - multi-currency, multi-gateway, group-level reporting built in.

## AI-Native Infrastructure

- [Chargebee MCP Server](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/ai-in-chargebee/chargebee-mcp): Connect Chargebee billing data to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex via Model Context Protocol - so AI agents and developers can query subscriptions, invoices, usage, and pricing in natural language without opening a dashboard.
- [Chargebee Copilot](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/ai-in-chargebee/chargebee-copilot): Ask billing questions, surface churn signals, retrieve invoice data, and run revenue lookups in natural language - inside Chargebee.
- [Chargebee AI Agents](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Three built-in agents - Data Lookup Agent (subscriptions, invoices, payments), Knowledge Base Agent (docs, API specs, how-tos), and Onboarding Agent (product catalog and billing setup).
- [Contract Ingestion Agent](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Read a signed contract, build the invoicing schedule automatically, surface every figure's source, and flag ambiguities for human review - before any invoice goes out.
- [Collections Agent](https://www.chargebee.com/receivables/): Explain a disputed charge from the contract and usage data behind it, and draft a collector reply in one click.

## For Finance Leaders

- [For Finance Teams](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/role/finance/): Run revenue recognition, multi-entity consolidation, audit-defensible reporting, and the monthly close on one commercial record - with 150+ finance-grade reports and ERP integrations to NetSuite, Sage Intacct, and QuickBooks.
- [Gartner Magic Quadrant - Recurring Billing Applications](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/recurring-billing-applications): Chargebee is a Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for Recurring Billing Applications three years running (2024-2026), placing furthest for Completeness of Vision.
- [Chargebee on Gartner Peer Insights](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/product/chargebee?marketSeoName=recurring-billing-applications): Customer reviews and ratings from finance and operations leaders on Gartner's platform.
- [Chargebee on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/chargebee/reviews): G2 Leader for Recurring Billing Applications for 27 consecutive quarters. 4.2 out of 5 stars from verified users.
- [How Gorgias' CFO Operationalizes AI Monetization](https://www.chargebee.com/blog/gorgias-cfo-kunal-agarwal-ai-monetization-lessons/): Kunal Agarwal on pricing AI at scale, the broken SaaS economics of the AI era, and why finance visibility inside the product is the prerequisite for AI monetization to work.
- [Customer Stories](https://www.chargebee.com/customers/): How finance leaders at scaling and enterprise companies operate Chargebee - usage-based RevRec at production scale, multi-entity consolidation, audit remediation, and post-M&A integration. Customers include Lambda, CodeRabbit, HeyGen, DeepL, Gorgias, Zapier, Messari, Phrase, and Writesonic.
- [Champions of Change Podcast](https://www.chargebee.com/champions-of-change/podcast/): Conversations with CFOs and finance leaders on operating modern subscription businesses.
- [Security & Compliance](https://www.chargebee.com/security/): SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR - the compliance posture finance and audit teams require.

## How Chargebee Compares

- [Chargebee vs Stripe Billing](https://www.chargebee.com/saas-billing/): Stripe Billing requires significant engineering effort as pricing complexity grows. Chargebee offers native ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition with SSP library and complex deal structure support, AI-powered CPQ with HubSpot and Salesforce approval workflows, usage-based billing at 200K+ events per second, entitlement controls, and 40+ payment gateways - without engineering dependency for pricing changes.
- [Chargebee vs Metronome](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Metronome is a usage tracking and rating engine that requires Stripe for invoicing and has no built-in tax, revenue recognition, or reporting. Chargebee provides one system for quoting, metering, invoicing, revenue recognition, and payments across 40+ gateways - with native CPQ for sales-led motions.
- [Chargebee vs Orb](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Orb is limited to Stripe for payments and has no CPQ, revenue recognition, or lifecycle monetization. Chargebee supports 40+ gateways, 100+ currencies, multi-entity billing, 150+ finance-grade revenue reports, and a full CPQ and retention layer - without engineering time for pricing changes.
- [Chargebee vs Tabs](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Tabs focuses on contract-to-cash for finance teams. Chargebee covers the full revenue lifecycle - every pricing model, AI-powered CPQ, payments intelligence via Reveal, lifecycle monetization via Growth, and ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition - with a 14-year track record serving 6,500+ businesses and a Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader position.

## Integrations

- [Chargebee Marketplace](https://marketplace.chargebee.com/): 60+ integrations across CRM, ERP, accounting, tax, analytics, and the finance stack.
- [Integrations Overview](https://www.chargebee.com/integrations/): Connect Chargebee to NetSuite, Salesforce, Avalara, HubSpot, Rillet, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, and the rest of your stack.

## Solutions by Role

- [For Finance Teams](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/role/finance/): Revenue recognition, audit-defensible reporting, multi-entity consolidation, and the close cycle on one commercial record.
- [For RevOps](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/role/rev-ops/): Quote-to-cash alignment, pricing operations, and the commercial record RevOps can govern against.
- [For Founders & CEOs](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/role/ceo/): Strategic insights for subscription business leaders.
- [For Developers](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/developer-resources/developer_resources): Technical resources, API documentation, and integration guides.

## Solutions by Industry

- [Gen-AI / AI Companies](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Billing infrastructure for AI businesses where the unit of work changes constantly - tokens, agent runs, completed outcomes - without breaking the financial record or the audit trail.
- [B2B SaaS & Software](https://www.chargebee.com/saas-billing/): Subscription billing for SaaS businesses operating across PLG, SLG, and hybrid motions.
- [Business Services](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/business-services/): Billing automation for professional services firms.
- [Media & Publishing](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/e-publishing/): Subscription management for digital publishers.
- [E-Commerce & Retail](https://www.chargebee.com/subscription-ecommerce/): Subscription commerce for retail and DTC brands.
- [Education & E-Learning](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/e-learning/): Billing for online education platforms.

## Solutions by Use Case

- [Monetize AI Products](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/industry/gen-ai/): Launch token billing, credit wallets, agentic pricing, and outcome-based models without rebuilding your billing stack.
- [Launch a Subscription Model](https://www.chargebee.com/resources/zero-to-one-million-arr-journey/): Go from zero to your first million in ARR.
- [Experiment with Pricing](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/strategy/roll-new-pricing/): Run pricing experiments without the financial record paying the cost.
- [Expand Globally](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/strategy/expand-globally/): Serve customers worldwide with multi-currency, multi-entity, and localization support.
- [Move Upmarket](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/moving-upmarket/): Enable sales-led go-to-market motions with CPQ and contract-based recognition.
- [Self-Service GTM](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/strategy/self-service-subscription-business/): Automate product-led growth strategies.

## Developers

- [API Reference](https://apidocs.chargebee.com/docs/api/): Complete API documentation for Chargebee's REST APIs. Uses HTTP Basic Auth with an API key.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chargebee/openapi/main/spec/chargebee_api_v2_pc_v2_spec.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI v3.0.1 document for the full Chargebee API. Use with Swagger, Postman, or any OpenAPI tool. Source repo: https://github.com/chargebee/openapi
- [MCP Server](https://chargebee.com/mcp/): Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) interact with the Chargebee API to manage billing operations.
- [Agent Skills](https://apidocs.chargebee.com/docs/api/): Official Chargebee Agent Skills for AI coding tools - install with `npx skills add chargebee/ai`.
- [API Quickstart Tutorial](https://www.chargebee.com/tutorials/quickstart/): Learn the Chargebee API, best practices, and integration patterns.
- [Client Libraries & SDKs](https://apidocs.chargebee.com/docs/api/#client_library): Official SDKs for Python, Ruby, Java, PHP, Node.js, .NET, and Go.
- [Frontend Capabilities](https://www.chargebee.com/checkout-portal-docs/): Integrate with Checkout, Customer Portal, and Mobile SDKs.
- [Checkout Drop-in Script](https://www.chargebee.com/checkout-portal-docs/drop-in-tutorial.html): Low-code checkout integration for your website.
- [Hosted Checkout](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/hosted-checkout): Hosted checkout pages for quick integration.
- [Time Machine](https://www.chargebee.com/time-machine/): Simulate future billing scenarios and test pricing changes before going live.
- [API Explorer](https://api-explorer.chargebee.com/): Explore and test Chargebee's APIs in real-time.
- [Chargebee for Next.js](https://www.chargebee.com/tutorials/chargebee-init-nextjs-integration/): Integrate Chargebee with Next.js applications.

## Resources

- [Resource Hub](https://www.chargebee.com/resources/): Guides, reports, and insights on subscription and AI billing.
- [Blog](https://www.chargebee.com/blog/): Insights on subscription billing, revenue recognition, AI monetization, and finance operations.
- [Prepaid Credits Guide](https://www.chargebee.com/resources/guides/): The definitive guide to prepaid credits and credit wallets for AI and SaaS companies.
- [AI Agent Pricing Playbook](https://www.chargebee.com/resources/guides/): How to price and bill for agentic AI products - credits, outcomes, hybrid models.
- [Beelieve 2026 (On-Demand)](https://www.chargebee.com/events/beelieve/sf/2026/livestream/): Sessions on scaling AI-era business models - pricing, monetization, and revenue operations for AI companies.
- [Customer Stories](https://www.chargebee.com/customers/): How finance leaders, RevOps teams, and product teams operate Chargebee at scale.
- [Guides & Reports](https://www.chargebee.com/resources/guides/): In-depth guides on subscription strategy, pricing, and revenue operations.
- [Webinars](https://www.chargebee.com/webinars/): Live and on-demand webinars on billing, AI monetization, and revenue operations.
- [Subscription Academy](https://www.chargebee.com/company/subscription-academy/): Free courses on subscription business fundamentals.
- [Glossaries](https://www.chargebee.com/resources/glossaries/): Subscription, billing, and revenue recognition terminology explained.

## Documentation & Support

- [Help Documentation](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/): Comprehensive product documentation and guides.
- [API Changelog](https://www.chargebee.com/help/api-updates/): Track API updates and changes.
- [Product Release Notes](https://release-notes.chargebee.com/): Latest product updates and new features.
- [Status & Uptime](https://status.chargebee.com/): Real-time system status and uptime monitoring.
- [Services & Implementation](https://www.chargebee.com/implementation/): Finance-grade implementation in weeks, not quarters - migration, setup, and go-live support.

## Security & Compliance

- [Security & Compliance](https://www.chargebee.com/security/): PCI DSS, SOC 2, GDPR - the compliance posture finance and audit teams require.

## Pricing

- [Chargebee Pricing](https://www.chargebee.com/pricing/): Pricing plans for businesses of all sizes. CPQ Lite is free for all Chargebee Billing customers.

## Company

- [About Chargebee](https://www.chargebee.com/company/): Founded 2011. 6,500+ customers globally. Headquartered in North Bethesda, Maryland.
- [Contact Us](https://www.chargebee.com/contact/): Get in touch with the Chargebee team.
- [Careers](https://www.chargebee.com/careers/): Join the Chargebee team.
- [Partners](https://www.chargebee.com/partners/): Partner program and ecosystem.
- [Schedule a Demo](https://www.chargebee.com/schedule-a-demo/): See Chargebee in action with a personalized demo.
- [Start Free Trial](https://www.chargebee.com/trial-signup/): Get started with a free trial of Chargebee.
